subject.title: showInjected persists injected context into session history, degrading OpenAI-compatible prompt-cache hit rates

question: Should `showInjected` be defined as display-only, with hook-injected context excluded from persisted and replayed session history by default?
rationale: The documentation distinguishes prompt-time injections from transcript mutation, but it does not state whether retaining injected text in live session history is intentional; changing that behavior affects plugin and session compatibility.

options.title: Adopt clean-history semantics
options.body: Keep injected context prompt-local while preserving a display-only representation for users and diagnostics.

options.title: Preserve current replay semantics
options.body: Keep injected text in live history and document that plugins needing cache-stable history must use a different injection seam.

recommendation.title: Adopt clean-history semantics
recommendation.body: Keep injected context prompt-local while preserving a display-only representation for users and diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent work covered normalized hook-injected context and is the closest available history signal for this lifecycle decision.
